headline: Julia Wolf just landed her FIRST No. 1 single with “In My Room” 🐺🔥 The track has reached
body:
Julia Wolf just landed her FIRST No. 1 single with “In My Room” 🐺🔥

The track has reached the top spot at US Alternative radio on Mediabase, making her the first female solo artist to lead the chart in over a year, according to Chart Data 📈

Have you been listening to Julia Wolf? 👀
